page_title: GIR 7-0 GRA | Girona v Granada CF 24/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Solis Romero J. E. Muscle Injury

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Savio (Girona) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
90+4' Yan Couto (Girona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

90+2' Savio (Girona) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Marc Martinez makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom right corner.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' 7 - 0 Goal! Artem Dovbyk (Girona) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Marc Martinez into right side of the goal.
89' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

89' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Girona.
88' Aleix Garcia (Girona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

87' Yan Couto (Girona) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
86' Daley Blind (Girona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
86' Girona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
86' Savio (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Good work from Girona as they win a corner.
84' Pablo Torre (Girona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
84' Savio (Girona) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
82' Eric Garcia (Girona) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
81' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is flagged for offside once again, but it was a very tight call this time.
78' 6 - 0 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Artem Dovbyk and Cristhian Stuani (Girona) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 6:0.
78' A quickly taken corner by Girona.
78' Yan Couto (Girona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Girona.
75' 5 - 0 Artem Dovbyk (Girona) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
73' Eric Garcia (Girona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
72' Here is a change. Ricard Sanchez is going off and Jose Ramon Sandoval gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Saenz (Granada CF).
72' Substitution. Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) replaces Raul Torrente.
72' Yan Couto (Girona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Artem Dovbyk, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
72' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Paulo Gazzaniga to make a comfortable save.
71' Savio (Girona) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

68' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) reacts well to meet the lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but sends a weak header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
67' Savio (Girona) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arnau Martinez (Girona) replaces Miguel Gutierrez.
65' Yan Couto (Girona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.
64' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
62' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
61' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!

61' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) wins himself just enough space to meet the resulting corner and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a great save and gets the ball under control.
60' The ball goes behind for a corner. Granada CF will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
60' It's time for a substitution. Miguel Brau (Granada CF) comes on in place of Faitout Maouassa.
60' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Granada CF.
60' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

58' Close! Artem Dovbyk (Girona) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.
56' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cristhian Stuani (Girona) replacing Viktor Tsygankov.
56' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

54' 4 - 0 Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) changes the score of today’s match. He ran on to a great pass, unleashed a low drive that went in off the post and into the bottom right corner past the goalkeeper.
53' A pass from Savio (Girona) is intercepted by Marc Martinez and the move breaks down.
52' The attendance is 12813.
50' Substitution. Savio (Girona) on for Portu.
50' Michel prepares a substitution. David Lopez is replaced by Yan Couto (Girona).
50' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pablo Torre (Girona) is coming onto the pitch as Yangel Herrera cannot continue after picking up an injury.
49' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Artem Dovbyk (Girona) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
48' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jose Callejon.
47' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Paulo Gazzaniga makes a great save.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Jose Ramon Sandoval probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF). He is replaced by Kamil Piatkowski.
46' Jose Ramon Sandoval makes a half-time substitution. Jose Callejon comes on in place of Sergio Rodelas (Granada CF).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Alejandro Ruiz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Portu (Girona).
45+3' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
45+3' Granada CF take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45+2' A cross into the box from Sergio Rodelas (Granada CF) is cleared. Granada CF have been awarded a corner kick.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 3 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Artem Dovbyk (Girona) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Marc Martinez no chance!
44' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
43' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
43' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a penalty to Girona! Let's see who's going to take it.
42' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
39' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Ruiz had an easy-decision to make.
36' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

33' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Miguel Gutierrez, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Viktor Tsygankov (Girona), who beats Marc Martinez with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
32' David Lopez (Girona) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
30' 1 - 0 Goal! Eric Garcia (Girona) makes the score 1:0 after burying a close-range header in the right side of the goal after a good run and cross by Viktor Tsygankov.
30' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) works the corner short.
29' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Girona will have a chance to score from a corner.
28' Yangel Herrera (Girona) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.

26' Great solo effort by Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) as he tricks his way through the defence before firing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. Marc Martinez is alert and denies him.
25' Faitout Maouassa (Granada CF) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles over the bar.
25' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
24' Eric Garcia (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Girona will take a corner.
22' Aleix Garcia (Girona) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.
21' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
19' Yangel Herrera (Girona) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
16' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.

16' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Alejandro Ruiz blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Girona have a free kick from a promising distance.
13' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
11' Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul after Lucas Boye (Granada CF) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
9' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to Yangel Herrera (Girona) who directs his shot to the left side of the goal, but the keeper is there in time to stop his effort.
5' The ball is crossed into the box and Portu (Girona) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Marc Martinez gets a glove on it to thwart him.
3' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

1' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Granada CF will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Alejandro Ruiz.
